subject: AtlasPay: urgent data handling & audit evidence during service degradation
messages:
From: Lucy Chen <lucy.chen@atlaspay.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: support@atlaspay.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in latency + 5xx rate — need preservation of artifacts

Marissa —

We started seeing a sudden increase in end-to-end latency and 5xx errors on our payment routing flows around 07:40 PDT. Impacting ~12% of requests with timeouts and apparent tokenization failures (stack attached). Our ops team is asking Redwood to preserve any runtime traces, request/response logs, and KV cache snapshots for the time window 07:30–08:00 PDT. Legal also asked to preserve evidence for a potential post-mortem audit.

Can you confirm you will not purge or rotate logs for AtlasPay and provide a point of contact for chain-of-custody? Also need an estimate of how long raw artifacts will be accessible and whether we can get sanitized copies for our internal review.

Thanks,
Lucy
Lucy Chen
Head of Engineering, AtlasPay

Attachments: atlaspay_client_stacktrace_0721.txt (text)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Spike in latency + 5xx rate — need preservation of artifacts

Team — FYI: AtlasPay (ATL-4823) is escalating and legal wants preserved evidence. Please treat this as a preservation + chain-of-custody request. High-level asks from customer: full request/response traces (07:30–08:00 PDT), runtime logs, KV cache snapshots, and any autoscaler/instance events tied to that window.

Immediate asks:
- Can Eng produce a snapshot of traces and the KV cache state and where you will stage them?
- Security: what formal steps do we take to mark these artifacts under legal hold and record access?
- Operations: please stop any automated retention jobs that would expire data for AtlasPay (if applicable).

I will confirm to the customer once we have a short plan.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike in latency + 5xx rate — need preservation of artifacts

On Fri, Jul 21, 2028 at 08:20 AM marissa_cole@redwood.ai wrote:
> Team — FYI: AtlasPay (ATL-4823) is escalating and legal wants preserved evidence.

We captured distributed traces and the call-level logs from the serving cluster. Initial observations: a short-lived surge in queue time on a single GPU pool shard and several tokenization errors with the client SDK. I will:

1) Create a tarball of traces and request logs for the 07:30–08:00 window and stage to a restricted S3 bucket (redwood-preserve/ATL-4823/2028-07-21/).
2) Export a read-only snapshot of the KV cache for affected model endpoints (endpoint ids: rwd-bert-v2-03, rwd-chat-v1-07).
3) Snapshot autoscaler events and instance lifecycle logs.

ETA for staging artifacts: 90 minutes. I will not run any delete lifecycle on the staging prefix. Put a write-block on automatic retention for AtlasPay.

Attachments: incident-trace-index.txt (reference index)

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike in latency + 5xx rate — need preservation of artifacts

Thanks — labeling this as a legal hold event. Steps for chain-of-custody and evidence handling:

- Create a custody manifest (CSV) listing all staged files, checksums (sha256), who staged them, and the timestamp. Store manifest in redwood-preserve/ATL-4823/2028-07-21/manifest.csv and record the S3 version IDs.
- Generate a signed access log export for the staging prefix (no public access).
- Redact PII from request/response pairs on a copy for AtlasPay; leave raw artifacts in the secure bucket for legal review only. Redaction policy: mask full account ids, email addresses, and payment tokens; preserve request IDs and timestamps.
- Set bucket retention: 90 days with explicit manual review for extension; do not run lifecycle deletions until legal confirms.

I will coordinate with Compliance to register the hold and will provide a short custody report once the tarball and KV snapshots are staged.

—Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: lucy.chen@atlaspay.com
Cc: tom.alvarez@atlaspay.com, priyom_das@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 5xx rate — need preservation of artifacts

Lucy —

Thanks for the report. Short update and commitments: we will not purge logs or run retention jobs against AtlasPay artifacts for the time window you specified. Engineering (Priyom) will stage full raw traces and KV snapshots to a restricted staging prefix (redwood-preserve/ATL-4823/2028-07-21/) within ~90 minutes. Security (Soojin) will attach a custody manifest and enable signed access logs. We will also produce a sanitized copy with PII masked for your ops review.

Can you confirm whether AtlasPay legal will require a longer retention than our default (90 days) and whether you need explicit notarized chain-of-custody semantics? Also, do you want us to push the sanitized copy to your S3 or share through an encrypted transfer (Box/ShareFile)?

I will share the manifest and a short incident summary (PDF) when ready.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_incident_summary_20280721.pdf (draft)
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@atlaspay.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: lucy.chen@atlaspay.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 5xx rate — need preservation of artifacts

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick acknowledgment. AtlasPay Legal needs the following confirmed in writing:
1) Exact retention window (we need raw artifacts retained for 180 days by default for our audit).
2) A custody manifest with checksums and S3 version IDs.
3) Confirmation that no internal access (outside the named list) will be performed without AtlasPay written consent.
4) The format and redaction rules to be applied to the sanitized copy.

Please confirm today so we can note this on our side and escalate appropriately if needed. If Redwood prefers, we can raise an NDA addendum or an evidence-handling MSA clause — let me know.

Regards,
Tom Alvarez
Senior Counsel, AtlasPay
